summary:
Implementation plan for Bedrock / MCPE v1.26.52.3 texture manager improvements:
1. Vanilla Reference Texture Viewer & Selective .mcpack Packaging (shows all game textures with search, lets users view/compare vanilla reference sprites, and guarantees ONLY customized textures are packaged into the .mcpack download).
2. Ultra-Fast Async Connection Tree Optimization (memoized link extraction, virtualization/lazy branch expansion to eliminate any UI freeze/lag).
3. 'New Custom JSON / Texture Definition' Wizard Modal (button on Connection Tree that displays Bedrock v1.26.52.3 requirements, schema rules, and scaffolds corresponding JSON definitions and PNG slots).
4. Bedrock 1.26.52.3 Format & Code Reference Guide (detailed specifications for PNG RGBA, TGA 32-bit alpha, flipbook_textures.json, terrain/item texture atlases, entity geometry/texture linkage, and sound definitions).
